In the last few hours, shocking revelations have been leaked regarding a foiled terror plot on New Year's Eve. Four men have been arrested in homes in both Vienna and Graz. The others were to shoot down guests as they tried to flee the palace. However, their plan was foiled after a van containing the explosives was found to be parked illegally. When the vehicle was towed, the explosives were found and a bomb disposal squad was immediately dispatched. Police raids on the homes of the men took place shortly after. Four men were arrested, however a fifth member is also thought to be involved. The search for this member of the group is still ongoing. Thankfully, the attack was prevented. The ball was attended by several important politicians and Austrian celebrities such as President Norbert Hofer and the visiting Arnold Schwarzenegger. Security measures have been stepped up throughout the country.
